description: Land Acquisition - Milidduwa, Galle Four Gravets D/S Division, Galle District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, describing specific parcels of land to be acquired by the government for a public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of land lots, their locations, extents, and claimants, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
